baseline.name: causal_trailing_mean
baseline.note: every mart row belongs to a player with at least one prior game (as-of HISTORY_FLAG), so the causal trailing mean has player history whenever the warehouse holds the full stats history; the champion-candidate aggregates of the whole evaluation window (n exact, MAE and baseline MAE within 0.0001) match eval-20260911-20260911-asof_v1-d333de20-rf-oos2025, so every row's baseline is player history

population.description: players with a realized nflverse stats row in this week and at least one prior game, scored by the frozen model; not a reconstructed pregame roster universe. data_cutoff is the last completed week before this one: each row's features use only strictly earlier weeks (as-of).
exclusions: players without a stats row this week (inactive, bye, injured, not rostered)
players without at least one prior game (no as-of history)
